name: Io
source:
A prisoner at the same jail as [url=/c10893]Guys[/url]. Io is always cowering, and is very weak-willed. This makes him a large target for the sexually frustrated and stressed. He's treated like a stress-relieving sex toy by many of his fellow prisoners. 

[Based on the [URL=http://www.langmaor.com/l01/l0102.htm]official website's character profiles[/URL].]
